source.excerpt: Shared as a consumer rights helper for unfair fees, fines and withheld deposits, drafting each challenge for you.

body:
## What it does

A bill you believe is wrong goes in: an overdraft charge, a card fee, a ticket, a deposit that never came back, a refund refused after a cancelled trip, a penalty from the tax office. What comes out is the argument against it, an honest read on where you stand, and a draft in the form the other side expects. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @DennisonBertram shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
